323 passages · 8+ thinkers in this selection

Why this theme matters

This theme page collects 323 English passages that touch philosophy as a philosophical concern—whether as a concept to define, a value to pursue, or a problem to examine.

In the history of philosophy

Related discussions appear across Greek, Chinese, Indian, Islamic, and modern European traditions. Use the quotations below as entry points, then follow thinker pages for fuller context.

Thinkers in this collection

Aristotle , Heraclitus , Epicurus , Epictetus , Seneca , Marcus Aurelius , Lucretius , Augustine of Hippo

Frequently asked questions

What did philosophers say about philosophy?

They approached philosophy from ethics, metaphysics, politics, and lived practice. The passages below show several of those angles in compact form.

Where can I find philosophy quotes about philosophy?

This archive page is organized for that search intent: verified English quotations, with links to thinkers and related themes.

How should I read these quotations?

Read the sentence first, then check school and source. A quotation is a doorway into an argument, not a substitute for the surrounding text.
